description: US EPA Air Quality System certified monitor data for a county: daily values per monitor (mean, daily max, AQI, method, site) or annual summaries (mean, 98th/99th percentiles, exceedance counts) for PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2, CO or lead. County by name or FIPS code. Official quality-assured data, published about six months after measurement. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

county.description: County name (Los Angeles) or 3-digit FIPS code (037)

from.description: Daily mode start date YYYY-MM-DD (data lags ~6 months)

pollutant.description: pm25 (default), pm10, ozone, no2, so2, co, lead

to.description: Daily mode end date YYYY-MM-DD, same calendar year, max 31 days after from

year.description: Annual mode: a year such as 2025 (returns annual summaries instead of daily values)

name: gov_epa_aqs_air_quality
title: Gov Epa Aqs Air Quality
